PubMed, the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, and ClinicalTrials.gov were searched from January 1, 2000 to September 25, 2024. There were no language restrictions.

We conducted a meta-analysis including six relevant randomized controlled trials comprising 1,870 patients with acute stroke and a large ischemic core due to ICA or MCA M1 occlusion who were nondisabled prior to stroke, comparing EVT plus medical care with medical care alone.
